content.text: Most of the 27 house rooms are either inert or have their calls commented out. I'll release the shell's interior claim first, since that's the blocker every room comment names, and then see which rooms still don't place anything. I'll read the shell's box helper and its doorway and opening writes.

The box helper fills the whole footprint with wall and then carves the interior back to air, which is what locks it. I'll read the rest of the shell to see what else writes air into rooms (the chimney `hole` helper in particular) before I change anything.

The shell claims the interior in three places: the box carve (line 27), the chimney-stack `hole` carve at each floor (line 57) and the stack-cell `open` (line 78). I'll make the box a wall ring only, and make the chimney stacks solid brick through the rooms, as the plan says ("stand in the rooms"). Doorways and window openings stay as owned air, since rooms must not furnish those.

structured_output.summary:
Walk is ok in all 37 rooms; fit is 0 issues (was 96); make.sh passes with 0 refused writes, 0 off-palette and 0 unknown blocks on a 26.3 grid.
Root causes fixed between parts: the h4 helpers wrote 4 blocks too high (SITE_Y), the shell claimed every room's air so all house furniture was refused, and the roof used tuff/stone off-palette blocks.
Rooms: house furniture restored or redesigned (bedroom 2 and 4 and 3 from the run's removed-layout copies, dining room rebuilt, walkway/balcony lit); no DARK cells in any room; path and court dark cells cleared with 10 lamp posts.
left: Lawn is still dark: 2,071 grass cells at y1 (lawns, not paths/courts, so I left them); river sand (122) and the water surface are also dark.

Six rooms are still dim (1-7, no DARK cells): parlour library (11 dim cells), bedroom 4 (10), dining room (4), upper porch (4), master bedroom (3), east upper corridor (1). More lanterns would lift them to 8+.

Rooms that still hold only lamps, with the furniture the module headers describe missing: east upper corridor (21), east hall bath (23), west hall bath (20), guest bath (7), back hall morning room (8), powder room (10), parlour library (2). Their headers name layouts that aren't in the files; I didn't rebuild them.
Master bedroom (14) and bedroom 2 (16) are sparse: restored from the layouts in the run, not reviewed up close.

25 roof truss ties still sit over bottom slabs in the attic. build.mjs fills those slabs to full blocks after runParts (the fit check is clean), but the toolkit's truss planner should lift the ties itself.
Chimney hearths (P-hearth) are not built: the stacks are solid brick through the rooms, but no fireplace faces a room.
8 smooth-quartz dentils at x24 z38..56 y15..16 are orphans for `mcd check` (each touches the wall on one face). They are the roof's dentil cornice, left as designed.

Decisions for the owner: the grid is now saved as 26.3 (DataVersion 5023), because the kit's iron_chain and palette are 26.x names; if the target is 1.21.4, chains need to be `chain` instead. The chimney stacks now start at y1 so the cap sits at plan y28, not y27. The roof material is now an in-palette deepslate mix instead of slate, so the eave reads as deepslate tiles, not tuff. The parterre flowers are single-block (no peony/rose_bush), because fit flags the upper half of a double-tall plant as floating (a tool false positive).
